name: [LOCAL] Improve Operator Processes
description: Improve operator-specific processes: operator/processes/ files and Firestore project processes (e.g. p-web-*, p-publicfile-*). If a generic pattern emerges, flag it for the REPO Work-Layer process — do NOT upstream operator values.

steps.title: Investigate operator processes
steps.description: List processes in operator/processes/ and query Firestore for project-linked processes. Cross-reference with recent mission trees to find operator processes with high failure rates, missing steps, or poor coverage.
steps.accept_criteria: Operator process inventory with usage frequency and failure rates from work trees.

steps.title: Improve operator processes
steps.description: Edit operator/ process files or update Firestore process documents. If a generic pattern emerges (e.g. a process step that would work for any operator), flag it for p-improve-work-layer-repo — do NOT put operator values into a REPO process.
steps.accept_criteria: Process improved. Changes confined to operator/ or Firestore.

steps.title: Operator review
steps.description: Present the process changes to the operator for approval.
steps.approval_message: 📋 Operator process update ready. Here are the changes to your processes. Please review and approve.

steps.title: Land via local-improvement skill
steps.description: Land per the local-improvement skill: verify changes are confined to operator/ or Firestore. No PR to main.
steps.accept_criteria: No platform files touched. No PR. Changes documented.
